newsitem.title: USA: Swift sees signs of oil, natgas in Gibbs well.
newsitem.headline: Swift sees signs of oil, natgas in Gibbs well.

text.p: Swift Energy Co said on Monday that significant fracturing with strong indications of oil and natural gas were encountered in its Gibbs 1 exploratory well in Walker County, Texas.
The well was drilled to a vertical depth of 11,230 feet with a single lateral drilled horizontally 6,370 feet, the company said.
Swift has a 68 percent interest in the well and a 52,000 acre concession.

"We are cautiously optimistic on the outcome of this well. Since this is a new area to be developed using horizontal drilling, we plan to conduct extensive testing for evaluation of the formation and to gain sufficient data to properly design a production facility and guide further development plans," said Terry E. Swift, chief operating officer.
The company will move the drilling rig to another exploratory well.
